situation: I run a small candle shop on Etsy. A customer just messaged saying the gift set arrived and her mum loved it. I'd like to ask for a review without being pushy.
reply: That made my day, thank you for telling me! I'm so glad your mum liked the fig and cedar set. If you have a minute, a short review on the order page is how small shops like mine get found on Etsy. Two sentences is plenty. Thank you either way.
note: Ask right after the good moment, point to one place, say how short it is, and give a real out.

situation: Soy fotógrafa freelance y acabo de entregar las fotos de marca a una clínica dental. La directora, la doctora Ruiz, me dijo que le encantaron. Quiero pedirle un testimonio para mi web.
reply: Hola doctora Ruiz, me alegra mucho que las fotos le hayan gustado. ¿Le puedo pedir un favor? Un testimonio corto, dos o tres frases, me ayudaría muchísimo con los próximos clientes. Para ponérselo fácil, le dejo un borrador que puede cambiar o reemplazar: "Lucía hizo las fotos de la clínica en una mañana, sin interrumpir las consultas, y por fin tenemos una web que se parece a nosotros." Si prefiere escribir el suyo, mejor aún. ¡Gracias!
note: Para testimonios, un borrador listo para editar hace que casi todos digan que sí.

situation: I asked a client for a Google review two weeks ago after we renovated their bathroom. They said 'sure, I'll do it this weekend' and nothing yet. One reminder okay?
reply: Hi Tom, hope the new bathroom is treating you well. Just floating this back up in case it got buried: https://g.page/r/brightline-renovations/review. Totally fine if it's not your thing, and thanks again for having us.
note: One reminder, with the link so there's zero work. If nothing after this, drop it.

situation: 我是独立的钢琴老师。学生朵朵的妈妈张姐刚发消息说孩子四级考过了，特别感谢我。想请她帮我推荐给身边的家长，但不想显得太功利。
reply: 张姐，恭喜朵朵！这次四级弹得特别稳，是她自己这半年练得用心。想跟您提个小请求：如果身边有家长也在找钢琴老师，方便的话帮我推一下微信就行，不用多介绍，一句“朵朵的老师还不错”就够了。没有合适的也完全没关系，谢谢您一直这么支持。
note: 推荐请求紧跟在好消息后面，说清对方只需要做一件很小的事，再给一个真正的退路。

situation: I left my job at a logistics company in August. My manager there, Sofia, said she'd happily vouch for me. I want a LinkedIn recommendation but she's always busy.
reply: Hi Sofia, hope Q4 planning is going okay without me! Would you be up for writing me a short LinkedIn recommendation? I'm interviewing for ops lead roles this month and it would carry real weight coming from you. To save you time, here's a draft you can edit or bin: "Ana ran our Midlands warehouse scheduling for three years and cut overtime by 18% by rebuilding the shift model. She's who I went to when a plan had to work on the floor." No worries at all if you're swamped.
note: Former manager: a ready draft with one real number turns a 20-minute favour into a 2-minute one.

situation: 我做家电上门维修。李阿姨家的空调第一次没修好，我第二次上门免费换了零件，现在好了，她挺满意。想请她在美团上给个评价，但毕竟第一次出了问题，不太好意思开口。
reply: 李阿姨您好，空调这两天用着还好吧？第一次没能一次修好，让您多等了一趟，谢谢您的耐心。我们是小店，美团上的评价对新客人挑师傅特别有用，如果您愿意写两句，一分钟就够，搜“老陈家电维修”就能找到。不方便也完全没关系，以后家里电器有问题直接找我。
note: 出过问题又解决了的客人：先用一句话认下那次失误，再提请求，并给一个真心的退路。
